s.note: the little worm invites Sarah in to meet the missus
s.how: Toast 8 thick slices of fruit loaf until the edges crisp, butter generously and cut into fingers. Warm a teapot, add 4 tea bags and 1L boiling water and brew 4 minutes. Serve with milk on the side, like a guest in a burrow.

s.n: Bog of Eternal Stench garlic dip
s.note: the bog, but this one smells good
s.how: Wrap 2 whole garlic heads in foil and roast at 180C for 45 minutes. Squeeze out the soft cloves and beat with 250g cream cheese, 100g sour cream, lemon juice and salt until smooth. Serve with torn baguette for dipping.

m.note: Hoggle the dwarf and his little garden
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches in 2 tbsp oil. Soften 1 diced onion, 2 carrots and 250g mushrooms in the same pot. Stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp Worcestershire, thyme and 750ml beef stock. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours until tender. Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Serve the stew over the mash with chopped parsley.

w.note: the peach that sends Sarah to the masked ball
w.how: Simmer 400ml apple juice, 200ml water, 100g caster sugar, 2 tbsp honey and a split vanilla bean for 5 minutes. Add 4 halved peaches and poach gently for 10 minutes, then slip off the skins and chill in the syrup for at least 2 hours. Beat 250g mascarpone with 1 tbsp icing sugar. Serve two halves each with a spoon of mascarpone, a little syrup and crumbled almond biscuits.

d.n: Goblin King's spiced apple and pear punch
d.how: Pour 1L cloudy apple juice and 500ml pear juice into a pot with 2 cinnamon sticks, 3 star anise and 2 strips of orange peel. Simmer gently for 10 minutes so the spices come through, then strain. Serve warm in mugs with a cinnamon stick, or cool it and pour over ice, topping each glass with 50ml sparkling water.
